title: Lisa — Complete Character Guide & Talent Reference
summary: Complete reference for Lisa: 4-star Electro Catalyst user. Includes Normal Attack, Elemental Skill, Elemental Burst talent descriptions with scaling values, passive talents, all 6 constellation effects, and ascension material requirements.
content:
# Lisa — Complete Character Reference

## Overview
- **Name**: Lisa
- **Title**: Witch of Purple Rose
- **Rarity**: ★★★★
- **Element / Vision**: Electro
- **Weapon Type**: Catalyst
- **Nation**: Mondstadt
- **Affiliation**: Knights of Favonius
- **Constellation**: Tempus Fugit
- **Birthday**: 0000-06-09
- **Special Dish**: None

> The languid but knowledgeable Librarian of the Knights of Favonius who was deemed by Sumeru Academia to be their most distinguished graduate in the past two centuries.

## Combat Talents

### Normal Attack: Lightning Touch
Normal Attack
Perform up to 4 lightning attacks that deal Electro DMG.
Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to deal AoE Electro DMG after a short casting time.
Plunging Attack
Gathering the might of Electro, Lisa plunges towards the ground from mid-air, damaging all enemies in her path. Deals AoE Electro DMG upon impact with the ground.

**Scaling Values (Lv. 1):**
- 1-Hit DMG: 39.6%
- 2-Hit DMG: 35.9%
- 3-Hit DMG: 42.8%
- 4-Hit DMG: 55%
- Charged Attack DMG: 177%
- Charged Attack Stamina Cost: 50
- Plunge DMG: 56.8%
- Low / High Plunge DMG: 114% / 142%

### Elemental Skill: Violet Arc
Channels the power of lightning to sweep bothersome matters away.
Press
Releases a homing Lightning Orb. On hit, it deals Electro DMG, and applies a stack of Conductive status (Max 3 stacks) to enemies in a small AoE.
Hold
After an extended casting time, calls down lightning from the heavens, dealing massive Electro DMG to all nearby enemies.

Deals great amounts of extra damage to enemies based on the number of Conductive stacks applied to them, and clears their Conductive status.

**Scaling Values (Lv. 1):**
- Press DMG: 80%
- Press CD: 1s
- Non-Conductive Hold DMG: 320%
- Stack 1 Conductive Hold DMG: 368%
- Stack 2 Conductive Hold DMG: 424%
- Stack 3 Conductive Hold DMG: 487%
- CD (hold): 16s

### Elemental Burst: Lightning Rose
Summons a Lightning Rose that unleashes powerful lightning bolts, launching surrounding enemies and dealing Electro DMG.

The Lightning Rose will continuously emit lightning to knock back enemies and deal Electro DMG for so long as it persists.

**Scaling Values (Lv. 1):**
- Discharge DMG: 36.6%
- Duration: 15s
- CD: 20s
- Energy Cost: 80

## Passive Talents

### Induced Aftershock (Unlocked at Ascension 1)
Hits by charged Attacks apply Violet Arc's Conductive status to enemies.

### Static Electricity Field (Unlocked at Ascension 4)
Enemies hit by Lightning Rose have their DEF decreased by 15% for 10s.

### General Pharmaceutics (Unlocked Automatically)
When Lisa crafts a potion, she has a 20% chance to refund a portion of the crafting materials used.

## Constellations

### C1: Infinite Circuit
Lisa recovers 2 Energy for every opponent hit while holding Violet Arc.
A maximum of 10 Energy can be regenerated in this manner at any one time.

### C2: Electromagnetic Field
Holding Violet Arc has the following effects:
Increases DEF by 25%.
Increases Lisa's resistance to interruption.

### C3: Resonant Thunder
Increases the Level of Lightning Rose by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

### C4: Plasma Eruption
Increases the number of lightning bolts released by Lightning Rose by 1-3.

### C5: Electrocute
Increase the Level of Violet Arc by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

### C6: Pulsating Witch
When Lisa takes the field, she applies 3 stacks of Violet Arc's Conductive status onto nearby enemies.
This effect can only occur once every 5s.

## Ascension Materials
- **Level 20**: Vajrada Amethyst Sliver ×1, Valberry ×3, Slime Condensate ×3, Mora ×20000
- **Level 40**: Vajrada Amethyst Fragment ×3, Lightning Prism ×2, Valberry ×10, Slime Condensate ×15, Mora ×40000
- **Level 50**: Vajrada Amethyst Fragment ×6, Lightning Prism ×4, Valberry ×20, Slime Secretions ×12, Mora ×60000
- **Level 60**: Vajrada Amethyst Chunk ×3, Lightning Prism ×8, Valberry ×30, Slime Secretions ×18, Mora ×80000
- **Level 70**: Vajrada Amethyst Chunk ×6, Lightning Prism ×12, Valberry ×45, Slime Concentrate ×12, Mora ×100000
- **Level 80**: Vajrada Amethyst Gemstone ×6, Lightning Prism ×20, Valberry ×60, Slime Concentrate ×24, Mora ×120000
